title: Activity labels and links
responsibility: Formats recorded activity timestamps, agent states, counts and commit navigation.

inputs.name: commitHref.branches
inputs.description: Branch choices; uses the first or a retained-commit route when none exist.

inputs.name: plural.word
inputs.description: Singular word to pluralize by appending s unless the count is exactly one.

inputs.name: activityDisplay.agents
inputs.description: Registered agent roster with a working count or null for unknown.

outputs.name: agentStates
outputs.description: Labels for working, stale, ended, completed and failed agents.

outputs.name: commitHref
outputs.description: History address formed from the base and commit route.

outputs.name: activityTime
outputs.description: UTC date and minute for a valid timestamp; otherwise the original text.

outputs.name: plural
outputs.description: Count followed by the word in singular or simple plural form.

outputs.name: activityDisplay
outputs.description: Sentence stating the registered working-agent count, or that it is unknown when no agent has registered. Explicitly excludes unregistered agents.
